projects.description:
Chief Engineer, IRIS-V (2014-5)
Systems Engineering Team Lead, IRIS-2 and IRIS-4 (2011-2 and 2013-4)
Autonomous Subsystem Team, IRIS-3 (2012-3)

Illinois Robotics In Space is a multidisciplinary student organization formed to compete in the annual NASA Robotic Mining Competition. IRIS provides an opportunity for University of Illinois students to experience the development of innovative robotic systems in a peer-based learning environment, fostering systems thinking and collaboration though development, manufacturing, and operation of complex, space-oriented robots in a Systems Engineering framework.

Information on the NASA RMC at http://nasa.gov/nasarmc
